resources.string: An iPhone-style, chronological notification panel. New notifications stay prominent; ones you\'ve already seen recede into Earlier. Open the panel with the edge handle or the Quick Settings tile — this screen is only for setup.
Turn off to hide the edge handle and lock-screen view without changing their settings. You can still open the panel from the Quick Settings tile.
Read, open, dismiss and act on notifications.
Edge handle, and showing the lock-screen view.
Enable “Show on Lock screen” and “Display pop-up windows while running in the background”.
Required. Without it, MIUI keeps Chronotif disconnected after you clear recent apps, after a reboot, or whenever it closes Chronotif in the background.
Notification access is on, but Chronotif isn\'t connected. Tap Reconnect, then turn notification access off and on.
Notification access is on, but Chronotif isn\'t connected. Turn on Xiaomi autostart below, then tap Reconnect and turn notification access off and on once.
Greyed-out toggle? Android blocks this for sideloaded apps: open App info → ⋮ → “Allow restricted settings” (on HyperOS, the switch under Advanced settings), then try again.
Swipe down on the left half of the status bar to open Chronotif instead of the system notifications. The right half still opens Control Center. Turn on Chronotif in Accessibility settings.
Places an invisible strip over the left half of the status bar so swiping down there opens Chronotif. It does not read anything on your screen.
A thin handle at the screen edge. Tap or swipe it to open the panel. It lights up when something is new.
You can also add the “Chronotif” tile to Quick Settings.
Always hide content on the lock screen. When off, Chronotif follows the system setting and each app\'s privacy choice. Opening, replying and actions always require unlocking.

No accounts, no analytics. Notifications never leave this device. Only the time of your last check and these settings are stored. The only network use is the optional update check below, which downloads from GitHub and sends nothing.
Once a day, check GitHub Releases for a new version and install it. Android asks you to confirm unless “Install unknown apps” is allowed for Chronotif.
Lets updates install without asking each time (Android 12+).
%s failed to install before. Tap “Check for updates” to retry.
See what\'s new on GitHub Releases.
The update is signed with a different key than this install. Uninstall and install it manually from GitHub Releases.
Nightly includes changes still being tested. Switching to Stable waits for a newer stable release; it does not downgrade the app.
